soldier: Soldier head chestnut brown, mandibles purplish brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish brown, the hairs of the head capsule rather sparse. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin straight at the centre, the frontal slope about 23 degrees. Fontanelle small, pore-like and flat, 0.62 mm from the frontal margin. Labrum semicircular. Mandibles rather robust, the shaft rather slender and straight, the apices slightly curved, the mandibular basal ridge long and moderately inflated. The antennae are broken off, the flange over the antennal socket rather large. The waist region of the postmentum is narrow and long. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin broadly V-shaped, the lateral margins joining the posterior margin in a semicircle, the median concavity ratio 9%, the median area with about 6 hairs.
